findings.description: The draft under-specified the crews test surface for the touched briefing/review-gate files and would have let an implementer miss load-bearing Codex wording assertions.
findings.resolution: Expanded the explicit crews test list to include briefing-render, continuation-briefing, review-gate, and pretooluse-review-mail-first, and called out the golden/fixture risk in Risk Areas and story acceptance criteria.
findings.suggestedFix: Name the missing crews tests explicitly and clarify that Codex becomes a first-class tested rendering branch.

findings.sectionRef: Technical Constraints; Files to Create/Modify; Acceptance Criteria
findings.description: The draft said each plugin needed release/version updates but omitted the concrete plugin manifest files and the documented Ralph Codex release-gate commands.
findings.resolution: Added the six plugin manifest files to the file list, documented the Ralph Codex release gate in Technical Constraints, and tightened acceptance criteria around release-gate verification.
findings.suggestedFix: List the actual version-stamp files and treat the Codex generator/validator commands as explicit verification steps.
